description: A 1-of-1 masterpiece by Kendrick Cooley (5HUNITK). A black and gold monument coin crowned in red jewels, rising from cracked concrete — 2025 to 2026, rebuilt. From the crash — platforms & music rebuilt. This is the genesis 1/1 for the Cooley legacy: HERE, Black Coin, and the music. Edition 1 of 1. There is no mint function in the contract — this token can never be duplicated. Asking price is set by the creator at $90,000,000; value is determined by a willing buyer at sale.
name: The $90 Million Comeback
